notes: עַד־לָמוּת: *even unto* is taken as one expanded limit rendering shared by עַד and its לְ (rule 16's expansion sentence, no conjunction morpheme standing beside the preposition to take the *even*), headed on *unto* and on עַד as the governing morpheme; the competing reading leaving the לְ unrepresented is recorded in the unit.
The dative לְ of נָתַן לוֹ is unrepresented, the suffix taking the bare *him* (rule 40).
Both articles in בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם are unrepresented, *those* being the demonstrative pronoun's (rule 41).
